summary: Autonomous penetration testing framework that orchestrates AI agents for reconnaissance, classification, exploitation, and reporting, supporting bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes.
usecases: Automated security auditing and vulnerability discovery for web applications
Bug bounty hunting and continuous security monitoring
CTF practice and automated penetration testing workflows
ideas: Integrate with SIEM platforms for real-time threat intelligence and reporting
Extend support to wireless, IoT, and embedded device penetration testing
Build a visual dashboard for agent workflow orchestration and findings tracking
